![SentinelAI — Network Monitoring Platform](docs/assets/sentinelai-hero.png) # SentinelAI **Plataforma NMS full-stack** — discovery inteligente, topologia 2D/3D, hub **Zion**, monitoramento WMI/SNMP, alertas multicanal e inventário persistente. [![FastAPI](https://img.shields.io/badge/FastAPI-009688?style=for-the-badge&logo=fastapi&logoColor=white)](https://fastapi.tiangolo.com/) [![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-20232A?style=for-the-badge&logo=react&logoColor=61DAFB)](https://react.dev/) [![Celery](https://img.shields.io/badge/Celery-37814A?style=for-the-badge&logo=celery&logoColor=white)](https://docs.celeryq.dev/) [![PostgreSQL](https://img.shields.io/badge/PostgreSQL-316192?style=for-the-badge&logo=postgresql&logoColor=white)](https://www.postgresql.org/) [![Docker](https://img.shields.io/badge/Docker-2496ED?style=for-the-badge&logo=docker&logoColor=white)](https://www.docker.com/) [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-Proprietary-red?style=for-the-badge)](#licença) [Quick Start](#-quick-start) · [Árvore do Conhecimento](https://canonengineer.github.io/TreeofKnowledge/index.html?tree=sentinelai) · [Arquitetura](#-arquitetura) · [Discovery](#-discovery-engine) · [API](#-api) · [Roadmap](#-roadmap)
--- ## O que é **SentinelAI** é uma plataforma de **monitoramento e inventário de infraestrutura de rede** pensada para equipes de engenharia e NOC. Combina: - Scan de sub-rede com **Nmap configurável** (perfis quick → aggressive) - Inventário **ativo + inativo** em sub-rede completa (`/24`) - **Mapa de topologia** interativo (React Flow) com vista **3D** - Hub operacional **Zion** — painéis por IP/métrica (CPU, RAM, disco, temperatura…) - Coleta **WMI** (Windows) + **SNMP**, alertas multicanal e relatórios - Paginação no dashboard (eventos 10/100 · dispositivos 10/2500) - Roadmap de **estabilização** (Fase 0+) além das fases enterprise 15–21 --- ## Quick Start ### Pré-requisitos - [Docker Desktop](https://www.docker.com/products/docker-desktop/) - Docker Compose v2 ### Subir em 3 comandos ```bash git clone https://github.com/CanonEngineer/SentinelAI.git cd SentinelAI cp .env.example .env && docker compose up --build -d ``` Desenvolvimento com hot-reload na API: ```bash docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml up --build -d ``` > Em produção use `APP_ENV=production` com `SECRET_KEY` (≥32) e `ADMIN_PASSWORD` fortes. > Login com `admin123` força troca de senha no primeiro acesso. ### Acessar | Serviço | URL | Credenciais | |---------|-----|-------------| | **Frontend** | http://localhost:5173 | `admin` / `admin123` | | **API + Swagger** | http://localhost:8000/docs | JWT após login | | **PostgreSQL** | `localhost:5432` | ver `.env.example` | | **Redis** | `localhost:6379` | — | ### Primeiro scan 1. Login no dashboard 2. Informe a sub-rede (ex: `172.20.100.0/24`) 3. Escolha perfil **Padrão** (nmap + SNMP + inventário full subnet) 4. Clique **Escanear sub-rede** 5. Acompanhe **Total · Ativos · Inativos** em tempo real --- ## Árvore do Conhecimento Mapa **2D** e **Galaxy 3D** deste projeto (balões, modal de código) no hub central: **[SentinelAI na Tree of Knowledge](https://canonengineer.github.io/TreeofKnowledge/index.html?tree=sentinelai)** · [Hub completo](https://canonengineer.github.io/TreeofKnowledge/) --- ## Arquitetura ### Visão geral (C4 — Container) ```mermaid flowchart TB subgraph Clients WEB[React SPA :5173] MOB[Expo Mobile] DESK[Electron Desktop] end subgraph Platform["SentinelAI Platform"] API[FastAPI :8000] FE[Vite Frontend] CW[Celery Worker] DW[Discovery Worker] BEAT[Celery Beat] end subgraph Data PG[(PostgreSQL 16)] RD[(Redis 7)] end subgraph External NM[Nmap / ICMP] SNMP[SNMP Agents] LDAP[LDAP / AD] end WEB --> FE --> API MOB --> API DESK --> FE API --> PG API --> RD CW --> PG DW --> PG DW --> RD BEAT --> RD DW --> NM DW --> SNMP API --> LDAP ``` ### Stack tecnológica | Camada | Tecnologias | |--------|-------------| | **Frontend** | React 18, Vite, TypeScript, React Flow, Lucide | | **Backend** | FastAPI, SQLAlchemy 2, Pydantic v2, Alembic | | **Async** | Celery, Redis, filas `celery` + `discovery` | | **Discovery** | Nmap, python-nmap, SNMP (pysnmp), ICMP ping | | **Data** | PostgreSQL, JSONB (scan_options, extra_data) | | **Deploy** | Docker Compose, Helm, GitHub Actions CI | | **Observability** | Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry (opcional) | --- ## Discovery Engine ![Pipeline de Discovery](docs/assets/discovery-pipeline.png) ### Pipeline de scan ```mermaid flowchart LR A[POST /api/discovery] --> B{Job #1–100} B --> C[Celery discovery-worker] C --> D[Nmap / ICMP ping] D --> E[Hosts vivos] E --> F{Inventário} F --> G[SNMP + DNS enrich] F --> H[Marcar inativos] G --> I[(devices)] H --> I I --> J[Job completed] J --> K[UI: Total · Ativos · Inativos] ``` ### Perfis de scan | Perfil | Nmap | SNMP | Inventário /24 | |--------|------|------|----------------| | **Rápido** | Ping + top ports | Opcional | Não | | **Padrão** | SYN + scripts | Sim | Sim (ativos + inativos) | | **Profundo** | OS + UDP | Sim | Sim | | **Agressivo** | Timing T4/T5 | Sim | Sim | | **Personalizado** | UI avançada | Configurável | Configurável | ### Ciclo de jobs Os jobs de discovery usam IDs **#1 a #100**. Ao concluir o **#100**, o próximo scan reinicia em **#1** (histórico limpo, sequência resetada). --- ## Topologia 2D & 3D ```mermaid flowchart TB subgraph Map2D["Mapa 2D — React Flow"] RF[Nodes + Edges] LLDP[LLDP/CDP auto] MAN[Links manuais] ELK[Auto-layout ELK] EXP[Export PNG/SVG/PDF/VSDX] end subgraph Map3D["Mapa 3D — Map3DView"] CSS[CSS 3D transforms] H[Altura por status] TRF[Tráfego animado] end TOPO[topology_service] --> Map2D TOPO --> Map3D SNMP2[SNMP counters] --> TRF ``` - **2D**: editor completo estilo *The Dude++* — drag-drop, camadas, grupos, colaboração WebSocket - **3D**: projeção com altura por status (`active` / `inactive`) e links com tráfego SNMP --- ## Monitoramento & Alertas ```mermaid flowchart LR DEV[Devices] --> MON[Monitors] MON --> PING[ICMP Ping] MON --> HTTP[HTTP/HTTPS] MON --> TCP[TCP Port] MON --> SNMP2[SNMP Poll] PING & HTTP & TCP & SNMP2 --> MET[(metrics)] MET --> ANO[Anomaly AI] MET --> ALT[Alert Engine] ALT --> EM[Email] ALT --> TG[Telegram] ALT --> SL[Slack] ALT --> DC[Discord] ALT --> TM[Teams] ALT --> WH[Webhook] ``` --- ## Estrutura do repositório ``` SentinelAI/ ├── backend/app/ │ ├── api/routes/ # REST + WebSocket │ ├── engines/ │ │ ├── discovery/ # Nmap, SNMP, scan_options, subnet_scanner │ │ ├── monitor/ # Ping, HTTP, TCP │ │ ├── alerts/ # Multicanal │ │ ├── ai/ # Anomalias, Copilot, vision │ │ └── reporting/ # PDF, Excel, VSDX │ ├── models/ # SQLAlchemy ORM │ ├── services/ # Regras de negócio │ └── workers/ # Celery tasks ├── frontend/src/ │ ├── pages/ # Dashboard, TopologyMap, Alerts… │ ├── components/ # Discovery, Map3D, charts │ └── api/ # Cliente HTTP tipado ├── docs/ │ ├── assets/ # Ilustrações README │ └── PHASE-*-ROADMAP.md ├── deploy/helm/ # Kubernetes ├── mobile/ # React Native (Expo) ├── docker-compose.yml └── .github/workflows/ci.yml ``` --- ## API Documentação interativa: **http://localhost:8000/docs** | Endpoint | Descrição | |----------|-----------| | `POST /api/auth/login` | JWT | | `GET/POST /api/discovery` | Jobs de scan | | `GET /api/discovery/scan-defaults` | Perfis e limites | | `GET/POST /api/devices` | Inventário | | `GET /api/topology/graph` | Grafo 2D/3D | | `GET /api/events` | Timeline | | `GET /health` | Health check | --- ## Desenvolvimento local ### Backend ```bash cd backend python -m venv .venv && .venv\Scripts\activate # Windows pip install -r requirements.txt uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000 ``` ### Frontend ```bash cd frontend npm install && npm run dev ``` ### Workers ```bash cd backend celery -A app.workers.celery_app worker -Q celery,discovery -l info ``` --- ## Configuração Copie `.env.example` → `.env`. Principais variáveis: ```env # Discovery SNMP_COMMUNITY=public DISCOVERY_DEFAULT_SUBNETS=192.168.1.0/24 DISCOVERY_JOBS_MAX_ID=100 # Alertas ALERT_CHANNELS_ENABLED=email,telegram,slack,webhook # LDAP (opcional) LDAP_ENABLED=false ``` --- ## Roadmap
Estabilização (Fase 0+) — operação confiável - Fase 0 ✅: baseline SNMP/WMI, inventário honesto, backup — [PHASE-0-BASELINE.md](docs/PHASE-0-BASELINE.md) - Fase 1–2: SSE Redis, health real, compose prod, cobertura SNMP, canais de alerta na UI - Cronograma completo: [CRONOGRAMA-ESTABILIZACAO.md](docs/CRONOGRAMA-ESTABILIZACAO.md)
Fases 0–10 — Core → Enterprise - Fase 0/1: MVP — API, JWT, ping, discovery ICMP - Fase 4: SNMP, inventário persistente, asset history - Fase 5: HTTP/TCP monitors, SLA, RBAC - Fase 6–8: Map Editor, colaboração WS, 3D, VSDX, tráfego animado - Fase 9–10: Sites, NetFlow, multi-tenant, plugins, SNMP traps → [PHASE-10-ROADMAP.md](docs/PHASE-10-ROADMAP.md)
Fases 11–21 — Plataforma → Scale / SaaS - Marketplace, HA, Electron, PWA, CI/CD - Prometheus/Grafana, Helm, OpenTelemetry - Vault, service mesh, SOC2, Copilot LLM - Stripe billing, self-healing, map vision, CDN - Fase 20–21: multi-moeda, marketplace ratings, WebXR, tax regional → [PHASE-19-ROADMAP.md](docs/PHASE-19-ROADMAP.md) · [PHASE-20-ROADMAP.md](docs/PHASE-20-ROADMAP.md) · [PHASE-21-ROADMAP.md](docs/PHASE-21-ROADMAP.md) · [MAP-EDITOR-ROADMAP.md](docs/MAP-EDITOR-ROADMAP.md)
--- ## Contribuindo 1. Fork → branch → PR 2. Siga o padrão existente (FastAPI services + React components) 3. Não commite `.env` — use `.env.example` 4. CI: `.github/workflows/ci.yml` --- ## Licença Projeto proprietário — **CanonEngineer / SentinelAI**. Uso interno ou conforme acordo de licença. ---

# =============================================================================
# SentinelAI — LAB / DEV ONLY template
# Copie para `.env` e troque TODAS as credenciais antes de qualquer deploy.
# Em APP_ENV=production, SECRET_KEY e ADMIN_PASSWORD fracos bloqueiam o arranque.
# Valores abaixo são placeholders deliberadamente fracos — NÃO usar em produção.
# =============================================================================

# Database (LAB) — senha alinhada ao default do docker-compose.yml
POSTGRES_USER=sentinel
POSTGRES_PASSWORD=sentinel_secret
POSTGRES_DB=sentinelai
DATABASE_URL=postgresql+asyncpg://sentinel:sentinel_secret@postgres:5432/sentinelai
DATABASE_URL_SYNC=postgresql://sentinel:sentinel_secret@postgres:5432/sentinelai

# Redis
REDIS_URL=redis://redis:6379/0

# API
# Gere com: openssl rand -hex 32
SECRET_KEY=change-me-in-production-use-openssl-rand-hex-32
# development | production — em production, SECRET_KEY e ADMIN_PASSWORD fracos bloqueiam o arranque
APP_ENV=development
API_HOST=0.0.0.0
API_PORT=8000
CORS_ORIGINS=http://localhost:5173,http://localhost:3000
# LAN: ao abrir http://<IP>:5173 no outro PC, o proxy Vite evita CORS extra.

# Changelog — SentinelAI

## [2.2.7] — 2026-07-29

### Operação P1.3
- **Retenção de métricas:** `METRICS_RETENTION_DAYS` (default 90); Celery cleanup lê settings
- **Zion cobertura:** retention days, sample count, oldest metric, tabela sem WMI
- **Histórico profundo:** DeviceMetricsTab com janelas 24h/7d/30d; aba Histórico Zion com seletor de device + gráfico

## [2.2.6] — 2026-07-29

### Segurança P1.6
- Rate limits por IP além do login: auth sensível, AI chat (copilot/chatbot), writes (devices/topology), remediation
- Knobs `RATE_LIMIT_*` em config + `.env.example` (LAB-ONLY)
- Docs: `SPRINT-TRUST-P0` P1.6 ✅, `SECURITY-REVIEW-v2.2` atualizado

## [2.2.5] — 2026-07-29

### Operação P1.5 / UX mapa
- Tráfego no mapa: SNMP quando a porta casa; sem match → **Mbps simulado** + linha contínua/partícula (efeito clássico restaurado a pedido)
- Cards: pulse/glow por status (online/offline/aguardando)

## [2.2.4] — 2026-07-29

### Operação P1.2
- **Alertas:** silence/snooze por fingerprint (`alert_silences`), dedupe via `ALERT_SUPPRESS_REPEAT_MINUTES`, enrichment hostname/IP/site no payload
- UI: snooze na tabela + lista de silences

## [2.2.3] — 2026-07-29

### Operação P1.4
- **Inventário único:** `docs/feature-inventory.json` canónico; espelho sync em `backend/app/data/`; `sync` / `check-sync` no CLI; mount `./docs:/docs:ro` no Compose; CI valida alinhamento

## [2.2.2] — 2026-07-29

### Operação P1.1
- **Playbooks YAML:** motor de remediação carrega builtins de `engines/remediation/playbooks/*.yaml` e `CustomPlaybook` do DB; ações `log|ping|snmp|http|ssh|reopen_inactive|ack_stale_alerts|topology_gap`
- Dep: `PyYAML`

## [2.2.1] — 2026-07-29

### Trust P0
- **Zion SLA:** `sla_avg_pct` passa a ser média de uptime ping 7d (não mais cópia de `availability_pct`); UI distingue “Online agora” vs “SLA 7d”
- **Config restore:** aprovação HITL enfileira `run_config_restore` (SSH apply Cisco-like) com eventos applied/failed
- **Release:** plano `docs/SPRINT-TRUST-P0.md`; tag `v2.2.0` na base 2.2

## [2.2.0] — 2026-07-28

### Fase 8 — MSP / fechamento
- **SLA por site:** `GET /api/sites/{id}/sla`, contrato thin (`PUT .../sla-contract`), PDF mensal `report_type=sla`
- **Playbooks visuais:** canvas de steps no Platform (Autonomous) ligado ao motor + HITL
- **Hardening:** rate limit em `/api/auth/login`; backup agendável (`scripts/schedule-backup.ps1`)
- Docs: `docs/UPGRADE-v2.2.md`, `docs/SECURITY-REVIEW-v2.2.md`

### Fase 7 — Agent + CMDB
- Agent lab (`POST /api/agents/metrics`, `agent/sentinel_lab_agent.py`)
- Change feed CMDB + config unified diff + aprovação `config_restore`

### Fase 6 — Sensores + NOC Wall
- OID custom CRUD/histórico/limiares
- NOC Wall TV + URL tokenizada

### Fases 1–5 (resumo)
- SSE Redis, discovery SNMP, Zion, credenciais Fernet, Alembic/pytest/CI, LLM seguro

Consulte `docs/CRONOGRAMA-ESTABILIZACAO.md` e `docs/feature-inventory.json` para o inventário completo.

# SentinelAI — deploy HA (Fase 11)
# Uso: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.ha.yml up --build
#
# Adiciona réplica da API, Redis Sentinel (modo dev) e variáveis HA.
# Para produção, configure PostgreSQL streaming replica externamente.

services:
  redis-sentinel:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    command: >
      sh -c "echo 'sentinel monitor mymaster redis 6379 1' > /tmp/sentinel.conf &&
             echo 'sentinel down-after-milliseconds mymaster 5000' >> /tmp/sentinel.conf &&
             redis-sentinel /tmp/sentinel.conf"
    ports:
      - "26379:26379"
    depends_on:
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy

  api-replica:
    build:
      context: ./backend
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    command: uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --timeout-graceful-shutdown 8
    env_file:
      - .env
    environment:
      DATABASE_URL: postgresql+asyncpg://sentinel:sentinel_secret@postgres:5432/sentinelai
      DATABASE_URL_SYNC: postgresql://sentinel:sentinel_secret@postgres:5432/sentinelai
      REDIS_URL: redis://redis:6379/0
      HA_MODE: "true"
      API_NODE_ID: api-replica-1
      API_NODE_ROLE: replica
    volumes:
      - ./backend:/app
      - reports_data:/app/reports
    ports:
      - "8001:8000"
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
    cap_add:
      - NET_RAW

  api:
    environment:
      HA_MODE: "true"
      API_NODE_ID: api-primary
      API_NODE_ROLE: primary
      REDIS_SENTINEL_HOSTS: redis-sentinel:26379

  nginx-lb:
    image: nginx:alpine
    ports:
      - "8080:80"
    volumes:
      - ./deploy/nginx-ha.conf:/etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf:ro
    depends_on:
      - api
      - api-replica

# PostgreSQL streaming replica (dev)
# Uso: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.replica.yml up
#
# Primary: postgres :5432 | Replica read-only: postgres-replica :5433

services:
  postgres:
    command: >
      postgres
      -c wal_level=replica
      -c max_wal_senders=3
      -c max_replication_slots=3
      -c hot_standby=on
    volumes:
      - postgres_data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
      - ./deploy/postgres/primary/init-replication.sh:/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/01-replication.sh:ro

  postgres-replica:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: ${POSTGRES_USER:-sentinel}
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:-sentinel_secret}
      POSTGRES_DB: ${POSTGRES_DB:-sentinelai}
      PGUSER: replicator
      PGPASSWORD: replicator_secret
    volumes:
      - postgres_replica_data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
      - ./deploy/postgres/replica/entrypoint.sh:/entrypoint.sh:ro
    ports:
      - "5433:5432"
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
    entrypoint: ["/bin/sh", "/entrypoint.sh"]

  api:
    environment:
      DATABASE_READ_URL: postgresql://sentinel:sentinel_secret@postgres-replica:5432/sentinelai

volumes:

services:
  postgres:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: ${POSTGRES_USER:-sentinel}
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:-sentinel_secret}
      POSTGRES_DB: ${POSTGRES_DB:-sentinelai}
    volumes:
      - postgres_data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    ports:
      - "5432:5432"
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U ${POSTGRES_USER:-sentinel} -d ${POSTGRES_DB:-sentinelai}"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5

  redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    ports:
      - "6379:6379"
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "redis-cli", "ping"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 5

  api:
    build:
      context: ./backend
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    # Produção/estável por omissão (sem --reload). Dev: -f docker-compose.dev.yml
    command: uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --timeout-graceful-shutdown 8
    env_file:
      - path: .env
        required: false
    environment:
      DATABASE_URL: postgresql+asyncpg://${POSTGRES_USER:-sentinel}:${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:-sentinel_secret}@postgres:5432/${POSTGRES_DB:-sentinelai}
      DATABASE_URL_SYNC: postgresql://${POSTGRES_USER:-sentinel}:${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:-sentinel_secret}@postgres:5432/${POSTGRES_DB:-sentinelai}
      REDIS_URL: redis://redis:6379/0
    volumes:
      - ./backend:/app
      - ./docs:/docs:ro
      - ./agent:/agent:ro
      - reports_data:/app/reports
      - backups_data:/app/backups
    ports:
      - "8000:8000"
      - "2055:2055/udp"
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "python -c \"import urllib.request; urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:8000/health')\""]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 15s
    cap_add:
      - NET_RAW

  worker:
    build:
      context: ./backend
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    command: celery -A app.workers.celery_app worker --loglevel=info --concurrency=4 -Q celery
    env_file:
      - path: .env
        required: false
    environment:
      DATABASE_URL: postgresql+asyncpg://${POSTGRES_USER:-sentinel}:${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:-sentinel_secret}@postgres:5432/${POSTGRES_DB:-sentinelai}
      DATABASE_URL_SYNC: postgresql://${POSTGRES_USER:-sentinel}:${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:-sentinel_secret}@postgres:5432/${POSTGRES_DB:-sentinelai}
      REDIS_URL: redis://redis:6379/0
    volumes:
      - ./backend:/app
      - ./docs:/docs:ro
      - reports_data:/app/reports
      - backups_data:/app/backups
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
    cap_add:
      - NET_RAW

  discovery-worker:
    build:
      context: ./backend
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    command: celery -A app.workers.celery_app worker --loglevel=info --concurrency=2 -Q discovery
    env_file:
      - path: .env
        required: false
    environment:
      DATABASE_URL: postgresql+asyncpg://${POSTGRES_USER:-sentinel}:${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:-sentinel_secret}@postgres:5432/${POSTGRES_DB:-sentinelai}
      DATABASE_URL_SYNC: postgresql://${POSTGRES_USER:-sentinel}:${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:-sentinel_secret}@postgres:5432/${POSTGRES_DB:-sentinelai}
      REDIS_URL: redis://redis:6379/0
    volumes:
      - ./backend:/app
      - ./docs:/docs:ro
      - reports_data:/app/reports
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
    cap_add:
      - NET_RAW

  beat:
    build:
      context: ./backend
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    command: celery -A app.workers.celery_app beat --loglevel=info
    env_file:
      - path: .env
        required: false
    environment:
      DATABASE_URL: postgresql+asyncpg://${POSTGRES_USER:-sentinel}:${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:-sentinel_secret}@postgres:5432/${POSTGRES_DB:-sentinelai}
      DATABASE_URL_SYNC: postgresql://${POSTGRES_USER:-sentinel}:${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:-sentinel_secret}@postgres:5432/${POSTGRES_DB:-sentinelai}
      REDIS_URL: redis://redis:6379/0
    volumes:
      - ./backend:/app
      - ./docs:/docs:ro
      - backups_data:/app/backups
    depends_on:
      - worker
      - redis

  frontend:
    build:
      context: ./frontend
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    command: sh -c "rm -rf node_modules/.vite && npm install && npm run dev"
    ports:
      - "5173:5173"
    volumes:
      - ./frontend:/app
      - /app/node_modules
    environment:
      # Vazio = browser usa /api via proxy Vite (mesma origem, sem CORS, reconecta após restart da API)
      VITE_API_URL: ""
    depends_on:
      api:
        condition: service_healthy

volumes:
  postgres_data:
  reports_data:
  backups_data:

nodes.code:
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main, master, develop]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main, master, develop]

jobs:
  backend:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: backend
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:16-alpine
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: sentinel
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: sentinel_secret
          POSTGRES_DB: sentinelai
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "pg_isready -U sentinel -d sentinelai"
          --health-interval 5s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 10
      redis:
        image: redis:7-alpine
        ports:
          - 6379:6379
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "redis-cli ping"
          --health-interval 5s
          --health-timeout 3s
          --health-retries 10
    env:
      DATABASE_URL: postgresql+asyncpg://sentinel:sentinel_secret@localhost:5432/sentinelai
      DATABASE_URL_SYNC: postgresql://sentinel:sentinel_secret@localhost:5432/sentinelai
      REDIS_URL: redis://localhost:6379/0
      SECRET_KEY: ci-secret-key-not-for-prod
      ADMIN_USERNAME: admin
      ADMIN_PASSWORD: admin123
      APP_ENV: development
      NETFLOW_ENABLED: "false"
      SNMP_TRAP_ENABLED: "false"
      COPILOT_LLM_ENABLED: "false"
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pip install -r requirements-dev.txt
      - name: Feature inventory sync check
        working-directory: .
        run: python scripts/feature-inventory.py check-sync
      - name: Ruff lint
        run: ruff check app tests --select E9,F63,F7,F82
      - name: Compile Python modules
        run: python -m compileall app
      - name: Alembic upgrade
        run: alembic upgrade head
      - name: Pytest
        run: pytest -q

  frontend:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: frontend
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: "20"
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: frontend/package-lock.json
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          npm ci
          # npm optional-deps bug: rollup native binary may be skipped on Linux CI
          npm install --no-save @rollup/rollup-linux-x64-gnu
      - name: Build
        run: npm run build

  smoke-compose:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Prepare lab .env
        run: cp .env.example .env
      - name: Build images
        run: docker compose build api
      - name: Up core services
        run: docker compose up -d postgres redis api
      - name: Wait for health
        run: |
          for i in $(seq 1 40); do
            if curl -sf http://localhost:8000/health >/dev/null; then
              echo "healthy"
              exit 0
            fi
            sleep 3
          done
          docker compose logs api --tail 80
          exit 1
      - name: Tear down
        if: always()
        run: docker compose down -v

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Gera js/data/projects.js com árvores expandidas."""
import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys

ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
OUT = os.path.join(ROOT, "js", "data", "projects.js")
DATA = os.path.join(ROOT, "scripts", "projects-data.json")
CPE_FILE = os.path.join(ROOT, "scripts", "cpe-project.json")
VEYON_FILE = os.path.join(ROOT, "scripts", "veyon-project.json")
DROPBOX_FILE = os.path.join(ROOT, "scripts", "dropbox-project.json")
RESTAURANT_FILE = os.path.join(ROOT, "scripts", "restaurant-project.json")
CANONSYNC_FILE = os.path.join(ROOT, "scripts", "canonsyncengine-project.json")
EXTRA_FILE = os.path.join(ROOT, "scripts", "extra-projects.json")
DANGERZONE_FILE = os.path.join(ROOT, "scripts", "dangerzone-project.json")
SMARTHOME_FILE = os.path.join(ROOT, "scripts", "smarthome-project.json")
SMARTFERRARI_FILE = os.path.join(ROOT, "scripts", "smartferrari-project.json")
SENTINELAI_FILE = os.path.join(ROOT, "scripts", "sentinelai-project.json")
EAGLE_FILE = os.path.join(ROOT, "scripts", "eagle-project.json")
ADMIN_USER_MGMT_FILE = os.path.join(ROOT, "scripts", "adminusermanagement-project.json")
FILL_SCRIPT = os.path.join(ROOT, "scripts", "fill-full-code.py")


def main():
  if "--no-fill" not in sys.argv:
    subprocess.run([sys.executable, FILL_SCRIPT], check=True)

  with open(CPE_FILE, encoding="utf-8") as f:
    cpe = json.load(f)
  with open(DATA, encoding="utf-8") as f:
    others = [p for p in json.load(f) if p.get("slug") not in ("customize-veyon", "javascript-dropbox")]
  with open(VEYON_FILE, encoding="utf-8") as f:
    veyon = json.load(f)
  with open(DROPBOX_FILE, encoding="utf-8") as f:
    dropbox = json.load(f)
  with open(RESTAURANT_FILE, encoding="utf-8") as f:
    restaurant = json.load(f)
  with open(CANONSYNC_FILE, encoding="utf-8") as f:
    canonsync = json.load(f)
  extras = []
  if os.path.isfile(EXTRA_FILE):
    with open(EXTRA_FILE, encoding="utf-8") as f:
      extras = json.load(f)
  dangerzone = []
  if os.path.isfile(DANGERZONE_FILE):
    with open(DANGERZONE_FILE, encoding="utf-8") as f:
      dangerzone = [json.load(f)]
  smarthome = []
  if os.path.isfile(SMARTHOME_FILE):
    with open(SMARTHOME_FILE, encoding="utf-8") as f:
      smarthome = [json.load(f)]
  smartferrari = []
  if os.path.isfile(SMARTFERRARI_FILE):
    with open(SMARTFERRARI_FILE, encoding="utf-8") as f:
      smartferrari = [json.load(f)]
  sentinelai = []
  if os.path.isfile(SENTINELAI_FILE):
    with open(SENTINELAI_FILE, encoding="utf-8") as f:
      sentinelai = [json.load(f)]
  eagle = []
  if os.path.isfile(EAGLE_FILE):
    with open(EAGLE_FILE, encoding="utf-8") as f:
      eagle = [json.load(f)]
  admin_user = []
  if os.path.isfile(ADMIN_USER_MGMT_FILE):
    with open(ADMIN_USER_MGMT_FILE, encoding="utf-8") as f:
      admin_user = [json.load(f)]
  projects = [cpe] + others[:1] + [dropbox, restaurant] + others[1:] + [veyon] + extras + dangerzone + smarthome + smartferrari + [canonsync] + sentinelai + eagle + admin_user
  js = "/* Árvore do Conhecimento — " + str(sum(len(p["nodes"]) for p in projects)) + " nós */\nconst PROJECTS = "
  js += json.dumps(projects, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + ";\n"
  with open(OUT, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    f.write(js)
  for p in projects:
    print(f"  {p['name']}: {len(p['nodes'])} nós")
  print(f"Total: {sum(len(p['nodes']) for p in projects)} nós -> {OUT}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
  main()

![CanonPythonEcommerce Banner](docs/images/banner.svg) # CanonPythonEcommerce ### Plataforma de E-commerce completa em Python + Django **Loja virtual profissional com catálogo, carrinho, checkout, pagamentos PayPal, painel do cliente e painel administrativo seguro.** [Funcionalidades](#-funcionalidades) • [Arquitetura](#-arquitetura-do-sistema) • [Instalação](#-instalação) • [Fluxos](#-fluxos-do-sistema) • [Rotas](#-principais-rotas) • [Autor](#-autor)
--- ## 📌 Sobre o projeto **CanonPythonEcommerce** (baseado no projeto **GreatKart**) é uma aplicação web de e-commerce desenvolvida com **Django**, focada em demonstrar boas práticas de desenvolvimento backend em Python: autenticação customizada, gestão de produtos, carrinho de compras, pedidos, integração com **PayPal**, envio de e-mails transacionais e painel administrativo protegido. O projeto é ideal para: - Portfólio profissional de desenvolvimento Python - Estudo de arquitetura MVC em Django - Base para lojas virtuais reais com customizações - Aprendizado de fluxos completos de e-commerce --- ## 📸 Pré-visualizações ### Loja e catálogo de produtos ![Loja virtual](docs/images/store-preview.svg) ### Checkout e pagamento PayPal ![Checkout](docs/images/checkout-preview.svg) ### Painel do cliente ![Dashboard do cliente](docs/images/dashboard-preview.svg) --- ## ✨ Funcionalidades ### 🛒 Loja virtual - Catálogo de produtos com categorias e slugs amigáveis - Página de detalhes do produto com galeria de imagens - Variações de produto (cor e tamanho) - Busca por produtos - Avaliações e classificação por estrelas ### 🧺 Carrinho e checkout - Carrinho persistente por sessão/usuário - Adição, remoção e atualização de quantidades - Cálculo automático de subtotal, taxas e total - Checkout com formulário de entrega ### 💳 Pagamentos e pedidos - Integração com **PayPal** - Registro de pagamentos e pedidos no banco - E-mail de confirmação de pedido - Histórico de pedidos no painel do cliente ### 👤 Contas e autenticação - Cadastro de usuários com ativação por e-mail - Login e logout - Recuperação de senha - Perfil editável com foto e endereço - Dashboard do cliente ### 🔐 Segurança - Modelo de usuário customizado (`Account`) - Admin real em rota protegida (`/securelogin/`) - [![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-3.11+-3776AB?style=for-the-badge&logo=python&logoColor=white)](https://www.python.org/) [![Windows](https://img.shields.io/badge/Windows-Endpoint-0078D4?style=for-the-badge&logo=windows&logoColor=white)](https://www.microsoft.com/windows) [![YAML](https://img.shields.io/badge/Rules-YAML-CB171E?style=for-the-badge&logo=yaml&logoColor=white)](agent/config/rules.yaml) [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-Proprietary-red?style=for-the-badge)](#license) [Quick Start](#-quick-start) · [Tree of Knowledge](https://canonengineer.github.io/TreeofKnowledge/index.html?tree=eagle-offensive-platform) · [Architecture](#-architecture) · [Detection Pipeline](#-detection-pipeline) · [Console](#-local-web-console) · [Roadmap](docs/ROADMAP.md)
--- ## About **Eagle Offensive Platform** (EOP) is a defensive endpoint-security prototype built for **precision, speed, and operational efficiency**. It combines behavioral detection, declarative YAML rules, memory heuristics, and a local operator console — all focused on **protecting Windows hosts**, not offensive tooling. | Pillar | Description | |--------|-------------| | **NGAV** | Hash/reputation + process/path rules | | **Behavioral EDR** | Parent→child chains, LOLBins, ransomware precursors | | **Memory heuristics** | Safe metadata-based suspicious process tagging | | **Local console** | Live alerts, coverage map, scan & monitor controls | | **Cloud-ready design** | Telemetry JSONL, policy pull, isolate (Phase 2+) | > **Scope:** Defensive endpoint protection only. No exploits, malware payloads, or offensive modules. --- ## Quick Start ### Prerequisites - Windows 10/11 (MVP target) - Python 3.11+ - PowerShell ### Install & run console ```powershell git clone https://github.com/CanonEngineer/EagleOffensivePlatform.git cd EagleOffensivePlatform\agent python -m venv .venv .\.venv\Scripts\activate pip install -r requirements.txt python -m eagle console ``` Opens **`http://127.0.0.1:8787`** — live alerts, filters, rules, scan, and local monitor. **Does not** install a Windows Service. ### CLI commands ```powershell python -m eagle scan --once # Single detection pass python -m eagle scan # Continuous monitor (Ctrl+C to stop) python -m eagle scan --enforce # Apply kill/quarantine (lab only!) python -m eagle alerts # Show recent alerts python -m eagle quarantine # List quarantined files python -m eagle console --port 8787 # Web console ``` --- ## #!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Gera scripts/adminusermanagement-project.json a partir do repo AdminUserManagement."""
import json
import os
import re

BAT_ROOT = os.environ.get(
    "ADMIN_USER_MGMT_ROOT",
    os.path.normpath(os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "..", "bat")),
)
OUT = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "adminusermanagement-project.json")
SLUG = "admin-user-management"

FILES = [
    ("SetAdmUser/set_adm_user.bat", "SetAdmUser", "set_adm_user.bat"),
    ("SetAdmUser/Set-AdmUser.ps1", "SetAdmUser", "Set-AdmUser.ps1"),
    ("SetAdmUser/Install-SetAdmUser.ps1", "SetAdmUser", "Install-SetAdmUser.ps1"),
    ("SetAdmUser/GPO-Startup-SetAdmUser.ps1", "SetAdmUser", "GPO-Startup-SetAdmUser.ps1"),
    ("SetAdmUser/GPO-Startup-SetAdmUser.bat", "SetAdmUser", "GPO-Startup-SetAdmUser.bat"),
    ("SetAdmUser-Env/Get-SetAdmUserConfig.ps1", "SetAdmUser-Env", "Get-SetAdmUserConfig.ps1"),
    ("SetAdmUser-Env/Set-AdmUser.ps1", "SetAdmUser-Env", "Set-AdmUser.ps1"),
    ("SetAdmUser-Env/Install-SetAdmUser.ps1", "SetAdmUser-Env", "Install-SetAdmUser.ps1"),
    ("SetAdmUser-Env/GPO-Startup-SetAdmUser.ps1", "SetAdmUser-Env", "GPO-Startup-SetAdmUser.ps1"),
    ("SetAdmUser-Env/Set-SetAdmUserEnv.ps1", "SetAdmUser-Env", "Set-SetAdmUserEnv.ps1"),
    ("SetAdmUser-Env/set_adm_user.bat", "SetAdmUser-Env", "set_adm_user.bat"),
]

FUNCTIONS = [
    ("SetAdmUser/Set-AdmUser.ps1", "Get-ProtectedPassword", "SetAdmUser/Set-AdmUser.ps1"),
    ("SetAdmUser/Set-AdmUser.ps1", "Set-LocalAdminUser", "SetAdmUser/Set-AdmUser.ps1"),
    ("SetAdmUser/Set-AdmUser.ps1", "Disable-BuiltInAdministrator", "SetAdmUser/Set-AdmUser.ps1"),
    ("SetAdmUser/Install-SetAdmUser.ps1", "Save-ProtectedPassword", "SetAdmUser/Install-SetAdmUser.ps1"),
    ("SetAdmUser-Env/Get-SetAdmUserConfig.ps1", "Get-SetAdmUserConfig", "SetAdmUser-Env/Get-SetAdmUserConfig.ps1"),
    ("SetAdmUser-Env/Get-SetAdmUserConfig.ps1", "Get-SetAdmUserPasswordFromEnv", "SetAdmUser-Env/Get-SetAdmUserConfig.ps1"),
]


def slug(s):
    return re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", s.lower()).strip("-")


def read_file(rel):
    path = os.path.join(BAT_ROOT, rel.replace("/", os.sep))
    with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as f:
        return f.read()


def extract_function(full, name):
    pat = rf"(?ms)^function\s+{re.escape(name)}\s*\{{.*?^\}}"
    m = re.search(pat, full)
    return m.group(0) if m else f"# function {name}() — ver arquivo completo"


def nid(*parts):
    return slug(SLUG + "-" + "-".join(parts))


def main():
    readme_path = os.path.join(BAT_ROOT, "README.md")
    with open(readme_path, encoding="utf-8") as f:
        readme = f.read()[:4000]

    nodes = [
        {
            "id": nid("root"),
            "parent": None,
            "layer": "root",
            "title": "AdminUserManagement",
            "description": "Gestão segura de admin local via GPO: DPAPI + PowerShell + AD.",
            "file": "README.md",
            "code": readme,
            "implementation": [
                "Repo: https://github.com/CanonEngineer/AdminUserManagement",
                "Versões: SetAdmUser + SetAdmUser-Env",
                "2D + Galaxy 3D na Tree of Knowledge",
            ],
        }
    ]

    for mod in ("SetAdmUser", "SetAdmUser-Env"):
        mod_id = nid("dir", mod)
        nodes.append(
            {
                "id": mod_id,
                "parent": nid("root"),
                "layer": "module",
                "title": mod + "/",
                "description": f"Módulo `{mod}/` — {'config fixa' if mod == 'SetAdmUser' else 'variáveis de ambiente GPO'}.",
                "file": mod + "/",
                "code": f"# Diretório: {mod}/\n",
                "implementation": [f"path: {mod}/", "nó de agrupamento"],
            }
        )

    file_ids = {}
    for rel, mod, title in FILES:
        fid = nid("file", mod, title)
        parent = nid("dir", mod)
        file_ids[rel] = fid
        try:
            code = read_file(rel)
        except OSError:
            continue
        nodes.append(
            {
                "id": fid,
                "parent": parent,
                "layer": "file",
                "title": title,
                "description": f"Código-fonte: `{rel}`",
                "file": rel.replace("\\", "/"),
                "code": code,
                "implementation": [
                    f"path: {rel}",
                    "GitHub: https://github.com/CanonEngineer/AdminUserManagement/blob/main/" + rel.replace("\\", "/"),
                ],
            }
        )

    for rel, func, _ in FUNCTIONS:
        parent = file_ids.get(rel)
        if not parent:
            continue
        try:
            full = read_file(rel)
        except OSError:
            continue
        code = extract_function(full, func)
        nodes.append(
            {
                "id": nid("fn", func),
                "parent": parent,
                "layer": "function",
                "title": func + "()",
                "description": f"Função `{func}` em `{rel}`",
                "file": rel.replace("\\", "/"),
                "code": code,
                "implementation": [
                    f"Arquivo: {rel}",
                    f"Função: {func}",
                ],
            }
        )

    project = {
        "slug": SLUG,
        "name": "AdminUserManagement",
        "repoUrl": "https://github.com/CanonEngineer/AdminUserManagement",
        "color": "#7c3aed",
        "icon": "shield",
        "stack": "PowerShell 5.1 + GPO + DPAPI + AD",
        "summary": f"Cobertura: {len(FILES)} arquivos principais ({len(nodes)} nós na árvore).",
        "nodes": nodes,
    }

    with open(OUT, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump(project, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)

    print(f"Gerado {OUT} — {len(nodes)} nós")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Gera scripts/sentinelai-project.json com TODOS os arquivos de código do SentinelAI.

Árvore 2D + Galaxy 3D — cobertura completa do repositório (não curadoria parcial).
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
import re
from collections import defaultdict
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
OUT = ROOT / "sentinelai-project.json"

CANDIDATES = [
    Path.home() / "Desktop" / "SentinelAI",
    Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent.parent / "SentinelAI",
]

SKIP_DIRS = {
    ".git",
    "node_modules",
    "__pycache__",
    ".venv",
    "venv",
    "dist",
    "build",
    "backups",
    ".cursor",
    "reports",
    ".pytest_cache",
    ".mypy_cache",
    "htmlcov",
    ".eggs",
    "coverage",
}

SKIP_FILES = {
    "package-lock.json",
    "celerybeat-schedule",
    ".DS_Store",
    "Thumbs.db",
}

SKIP_NAME_PREFIXES = ("tmp_", ".")

CODE_EXTS = {
    ".py",
    ".ts",
    ".tsx",
    ".js",
    ".jsx",
    ".css",
    ".ps1",
    ".yml",
    ".yaml",
    ".md",
    ".json",
    ".toml",
    ".ini",
    ".bat",
    ".sh",
    ".sql",
    ".html",
    ".vue",
    ".dockerfile",
}

MAX_FILE_BYTES = 1_500_000
CODE_LIMIT = 7000
# Pastas com muitos arquivos viram subgrupos — evita fan-out que quebra layout 2D/3D
MAX_DIRECT_FILES = 12


def find_repo() -> Path | None:
    for p in CANDIDATES:
        if p.is_dir() and (p / "backend" / "app" / "main.py").is_file():
            return p
    return None


def path_id(rel: str, *, is_dir: bool = False) -> str:
    """ID estável a partir do caminho relativo."""
    s = rel.replace("\\", "/").strip("/")
    if not s:
        return "sai-root"
    s = re.sub(r"[^a-zA-Z0-9]+", "-", s).strip("-").lower()
    prefix = "sai-dir-" if is_dir else "sai-file-"
    return (prefix + s)[:120]


def read_code(repo: Path, rel: str, limit: int = CODE_LIMIT) -> str:
    path = repo / rel.replace("/", os.sep)
    if not path.is_file():
        return f"# Arquivo não encontrado: {rel}\n"
    try:
        raw = path.read_bytes()
    except OSError as exc:
        return f"# Erro ao ler {rel}: {exc}\n"
    if len(raw) > MAX_FILE_BYTES:
        return f"# Arquivo grande demais para embutir na árvore ({len(raw)} bytes): {rel}\n"
    try:
        text = raw.decode("utf-8")
    except UnicodeDecodeError:
        text = raw.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
    if len(text) > limit:
        text = text[:limit] + "\n\n/* … truncado na árvore (arquivo completo no GitHub) … */\n"
    return text


def collect_files(repo: Path) -> list[Path]:
    files: list[Path] = []
    for p in repo.rglob("*"):
        if not p.is_file():
            continue
        rel_parts = p.relative_to(repo).parts
        if any(part in SKIP_DIRS for part in rel_parts):
            continue
        if p.name in SKIP_FILES:
            continue
        if p.name.startswith(SKIP_NAME_PREFIXES) and p.name not in {".env.example", ".gitignore", ".cursorignore", ".nojekyll"}:
            # allow listed dotfiles that are project config
            if not p.name.startswith(".env") and p.name not in {".gitignore", ".cursorignore", ".dockerignore"}:
                if p.name.startswith("."):
                    # still skip most dotfiles except allowlist
                    if p.name not in {".gitignore", ".cursorignore", ".dockerignore", ".env.example"}:
                        continue
        if p.name.startswith("tmp_"):
            continue
        suf = p.suffix.lower()
        if p.name.lower() == "dockerfile":
            suf = ".dockerfile"
        if suf not in CODE_EXTS and p.name not in {".gitignore", ".cursorignore", ".dockerignore", ".env.example"}:
            continue
        try:
            if p.stat().st_size > MAX_FILE_BYTES:
                continue
        except OSError:
            continue
        files.append(p)
    return sorted(files, key=lambda x: x.as_posix().lower())


def build(repo: Path) -> dict:
    files = collect_files(repo)
    nodes: list[dict] = []
    seen_ids: set[str] = set()
    dir_ids: dict[str, str] = {"": "sai-root"}

    readme = repo / "README.md"
    readme_code = read_code(repo, "README.md", limit=12000) if readme.is_file() else "# SentinelAI\n"
    nodes.append(
        {
            "id": "sai-root",
            "parent": None,
            "layer": "root",
            "title": "SentinelAI",
            "description": (
                f"Árvore completa do repositório — {len(files)} arquivos de código mapeados "
                "(backend, frontend, mobile, docs, scripts, deploy). "
                "Estabilização Fases 1–8 + 9b (credenciais, wallboard, agent lab, CMDB, SLA, NetFlow UI)."
            ),
            "file": "README.md",
            "code": readme_code,
            "implementation": [
                "Repo: https://github.com/CanonEngineer/SentinelAI",
                f"Arquivos na árvore: {len(files)}",
                "2D + Galaxy 3D — cobertura total do código-fonte",
                "CHANGELOG v2.2 · docs/UPGRADE-v2.2.md",
                "docker compose up → http://localhost:5173",
            ],
        }
    )
    seen_ids.add("sai-root")

    # Diretórios que contêm arquivos
    dirs_needed: set[str] = set()
    for f in files:
        rel = f.relative_to(repo).as_posix()
        parent = str(Path(rel).parent).replace("\\", "/")
        if parent == ".":
            parent = ""
        # all ancestors
        parts = parent.split("/") if parent else []
        acc = []
        for part in parts:
            acc.append(part)
            dirs_needed.add("/".join(acc))

    # Criar módulos de diretório (profundidade crescente)
    for drel in sorted(dirs_needed, key=lambda s: (s.count("/"), s.lower())):
        did = path_id(drel, is_dir=True)
        parent_path = str(Path(drel).parent).replace("\\", "/")
        if parent_path == ".":

        parent_id = dir_ids.get(parent_path, "sai-root")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Atualiza metadados e nós do Professional-Scanner no projects-data.json."""
import json
import os

ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
DATA = os.path.join(ROOT, "scripts", "projects-data.json")

NEW_NODES = [
    {
        "id": "ps-autotest",
        "parent": "ps-root",
        "layer": "module",
        "title": "autoTest.js",
        "description": "Motor AutoTest L2/L3/L4: perfis, histórico, relatório de engenharia e export PDF/CSV.",
        "file": "autoTest.js",
        "screenshot": "docs/images/professional-scanner/autotest-results.png",
        "implementation": [
            "runAutoTest()",
            "perfis Canon / Integra",
            "data/autotest-history.json"
        ],
        "code": ""
    },
    {
        "id": "ps-autotest-ui",
        "parent": "ps-client",
        "layer": "function",
        "title": "renderAutoTestEngineeringBanner()",
        "description": "Banner EXECUTANDO animado, métricas PASS/AVISO/FALHA e cards em 3 colunas.",
        "file": "public/app.js",
        "screenshot": "docs/images/professional-scanner/autotest-running.png",
        "implementation": [
            "autotest-run-scroll",
            "loadAutoTestInterfaces()",
            "parseLegacyAutoTestSummary()"
        ],
        "code": ""
    },
    {
        "id": "ps-autotest-remote",
        "parent": "ps-autotest",
        "layer": "module",
        "title": "autoTestRemote.js",
        "description": "Execução remota estilo Veyon: pareamento, runner assinado e fila de jobs na LAN.",
        "file": "autoTestRemote.js",
        "screenshot": "docs/images/professional-scanner/autotest-remote.png",
        "implementation": [
            "enrollRemoteAgent()",
            "install-autotest-agent-service.ps1",
            "data/autotest-remote-keys/"
        ],
        "code": ""
    },
    {
        "id": "ps-oracle",
        "parent": "ps-root",
        "layer": "module",
        "title": "oracleUserLookup.js",
        "description": "Consulta usuários Oracle via SQL*Plus e ponte JDBC para correlacionar com AD.",
        "file": "oracleUserLookup.js",
        "implementation": [
            "oracleSqlPlusBridge.js",
            "scripts/oracle-bridge/OracleJdbcBridge.java",
            "GET /api/oracle/user"
        ],
        "code": ""
    },
    {
        "id": "ps-platform",
        "parent": "ps-root",
        "layer": "module",
        "title": "platformRoutes.js",
        "description": "Plataforma Canon: drift de rede, lifecycle de assets, NAC readiness, TLS e webhooks.",
        "file": "platformRoutes.js",
        "implementation": [
            "networkDrift.js",
            "assetLifecycle.js",
            "public/platform.js"
        ],
        "code": ""
    },
    {
        "id": "ps-auth",
        "parent": "ps-root",
        "layer": "module",
        "title": "canonAuth.js",
        "description": "Autenticação de sessão e RBAC para proteger endpoints sensíveis do scanner.",
        "file": "canonAuth.js",
        "implementation": [
            "canonRbac.js",
            "middleware requireAuth",
            "roles configuráveis"
        ],
        "code": ""
    },
]


def main():
    with open(DATA, encoding="utf-8") as f:
        projects = json.load(f)

    for project in projects:
        if project.get("slug") != "professional-scanner":
            continue

        project["stack"] = "Node.js + WebSocket + SNMP + AutoTest"
        project["summary"] = (
            "NetScan Canon v2: varredura, AD, AutoTest L2/L3/L4 local/remoto, "
            "Oracle, Plataforma Canon e monitor urgente de loop SNMP."
        )
        project["demoUrl"] = "https://github.com/CanonEngineer/Professional-Scanner#autotest-de-rede"
        project["screenshots"] = [
            "docs/images/professional-scanner/autotest-results.png",
            "docs/images/professional-scanner/autotest-running.png",
            "docs/images/professional-scanner/autotest-remote.png",
            "docs/images/professional-scanner/autotest-history.png",
        ]

        existing_ids = {n["id"] for n in project.get("nodes", [])}
        for node in project.get("nodes", []):
            if node["id"] == "ps-root":
                node["description"] = (
                    "NetScan Canon v2: discovery, enriquecimento AD, AutoTest, "
                    "Oracle, Plataforma Canon, ociosos e loop SNMP."
                )
            if node["id"] == "ps-client":
                node["description"] = (
                    "Dashboard: scan, ociosos, AD, Loop, AutoTest, Oracle e Plataforma Canon."
                )

        added = 0
        updated = 0
        for node in NEW_NODES:
            if node["id"] not in existing_ids:
                project.setdefault("nodes", []).append(node)
                added += 1
            else:
                for existing in project.get("nodes", []):
                    if existing["id"] == node["id"] and node.get("screenshot"):
                        existing["screenshot"] = node["screenshot"]
                        updated += 1

        print(f"Professional-Scanner: +{added} nós, {updated} screenshots, total {len(project['nodes'])}")
        break
    else:
        raise SystemExit("Projeto professional-scanner não encontrado")

    with open(DATA, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump(projects, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
        f.write("\n")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

install-windows.ps1
nodes.code:
<#
.SYNOPSIS
  Instala o SentinelAI Lab Agent no Windows (pacote lab — equivalente prático a MSI).

.DESCRIPTION
  Copia o agent para ProgramData, grava agent.json, opcionalmente instala psutil,
  e registra Tarefa Agendada "SentinelAI-LabAgent" (logon / a cada 1 min se cair).

.EXAMPLE
  .\install-windows.ps1 -Token "agt_xxx" -Url "http://localhost:8800"

.EXAMPLE
  # Baixar installer da API e instalar:
  irm http://localhost:8800/api/agents/install.ps1 | iex
  # (depois chame Install-SentinelLabAgent -Token ... se o script for função)
#>
[CmdletBinding()]
param(
  [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)]
  [string]$Token,

  [string]$Url = "http://localhost:8800",

  [int]$Interval = 30,

  [string]$InstallDir = "$env:ProgramData\SentinelAI\Agent",

  [string]$TaskName = "SentinelAI-LabAgent",

  [switch]$SkipPsutil,

  [switch]$StartNow
)

$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
$Url = $Url.TrimEnd("/")

Write-Host "=== SentinelAI Lab Agent installer ===" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host "URL: $Url"
Write-Host "InstallDir: $InstallDir"

New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $InstallDir | Out-Null

$agentPy = Join-Path $InstallDir "sentinel_lab_agent.py"
$agentJson = Join-Path $InstallDir "agent.json"
$wrapper = Join-Path $InstallDir "run-agent.cmd"

Write-Host "Baixando agent da API..."
try {
  Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "$Url/api/agents/package/sentinel_lab_agent.py" -OutFile $agentPy -UseBasicParsing
} catch {
  $local = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot "sentinel_lab_agent.py"
  if (Test-Path $local) {
    Write-Host "API indisponível — usando cópia local: $local" -ForegroundColor Yellow
    Copy-Item $local $agentPy -Force
  } else {
    throw "Não foi possível obter sentinel_lab_agent.py ($_)"
  }
}

@{
  url      = $Url
  token    = $Token
  interval = $Interval
} | ConvertTo-Json | Set-Content -Path $agentJson -Encoding UTF8

@"
@echo off
cd /d "$InstallDir"
where python >nul 2>&1
if errorlevel 1 (
  where py >nul 2>&1
  if errorlevel 1 (
    echo Python nao encontrado no PATH. Instale Python 3.11+ e reabra o terminal.
    exit /b 1
  )
  py -3 sentinel_lab_agent.py
  exit /b %ERRORLEVEL%
)
python sentinel_lab_agent.py
"@ | Set-Content -Path $wrapper -Encoding ASCII

if (-not $SkipPsutil) {
  Write-Host "Instalando psutil (métricas reais)..."
  try {
    & python -m pip install --quiet psutil 2>$null
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { & py -3 -m pip install --quiet psutil 2>$null }
  } catch {
    Write-Host "psutil opcional — agent usa fallback de lab sem ele." -ForegroundColor Yellow
  }
}

$pythonCmd = $null
if (Get-Command python -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { $pythonCmd = (Get-Command python).Source }
elseif (Get-Command py -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { $pythonCmd = "`"$((Get-Command py).Source)`" -3" }
else { throw "Python não encontrado no PATH." }

$action = New-ScheduledTaskAction -Execute "cmd.exe" -Argument "/c `"$wrapper`""
$triggerLogon = New-ScheduledTaskTrigger -AtLogOn
$settings = New-ScheduledTaskSettingsSet -AllowStartIfOnBatteries -DontStopIfGoingOnBatteries -RestartCount 3 -RestartInterval (New-TimeSpan -Minutes 1) -ExecutionTimeLimit (New-TimeSpan -Days 3650)
$principal = New-ScheduledTaskPrincipal -UserId $env:USERNAME -LogonType Interactive -RunLevel Limited

Unregister-ScheduledTask -TaskName $TaskName -Confirm:$false -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Register-ScheduledTask -TaskName $TaskName -Action $action -Trigger $triggerLogon -Settings $settings -Principal $principal -Force | Out-Null

Write-Host "Tarefa agendada registrada: $TaskName" -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host "Config: $agentJson"

if ($StartNow) {
  Write-Host "Iniciando agent agora..."
  Start-ScheduledTask -TaskName $TaskName
}

Write-Host @"

Pronto.
  - Pasta: $InstallDir
  - Task:  $TaskName
  - Ver status: Get-ScheduledTask -TaskName $TaskName
  - Logs: rode manualmente: & '$wrapper'
  - Remover: .\uninstall-windows.ps1

"@ -ForegroundColor Cyan

from logging.config import fileConfig

from alembic import context
from sqlalchemy import engine_from_config, pool

from app.config import settings
from app.database import Base
from app.models import *  # noqa: F401, F403

config = context.config
config.set_main_option("sqlalchemy.url", settings.database_url_sync)

if config.config_file_name is not None:
    fileConfig(config.config_file_name)

target_metadata = Base.metadata


def run_migrations_offline() -> None:
    url = config.get_main_option("sqlalchemy.url")
    context.configure(url=url, target_metadata=target_metadata, literal_binds=True)
    with context.begin_transaction():
        context.run_migrations()


def run_migrations_online() -> None:
    connectable = engine_from_config(
        config.get_section(config.config_ini_section, {}),
        prefix="sqlalchemy.",
        poolclass=pool.NullPool,
    )
    with connectable.connect() as connection:
        context.configure(connection=connection, target_metadata=target_metadata)
        with context.begin_transaction():
            context.run_migrations()


if context.is_offline_mode():
    run_migrations_offline()
else:
    run_migrations_online()

from collections.abc import AsyncGenerator

from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession, async_sessionmaker, create_async_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import DeclarativeBase

from app.config import settings

_ASYNC_OPTIONS = "-c idle_in_transaction_session_timeout=20000 -c lock_timeout=8000"

engine = create_async_engine(
    settings.database_url,
    echo=False,
    pool_pre_ping=True,
    pool_size=10,
    max_overflow=20,
    pool_recycle=300,
    connect_args={"server_settings": {
        "idle_in_transaction_session_timeout": "20000",
        "lock_timeout": "8000",
    }},
)
async_session = async_sessionmaker(engine, class_=AsyncSession, expire_on_commit=False)


class Base(DeclarativeBase):
    pass


async def get_db() -> AsyncGenerator[AsyncSession, None]:
    async with async_session() as session:
        try:
            yield session
            await session.commit()
        except Exception:
            await session.rollback()
            raise

from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker

from app.config import settings

# Evita locks eternos: transação idle > 20s é abortada; lock wait > 8s falha rápido.
_SYNC_OPTIONS = "-c idle_in_transaction_session_timeout=20000 -c lock_timeout=8000"

sync_engine = create_engine(
    settings.database_url_sync,
    pool_pre_ping=True,
    pool_size=5,
    max_overflow=10,
    pool_recycle=300,
    connect_args={"options": _SYNC_OPTIONS},
)
SyncSession = sessionmaker(bind=sync_engine, expire_on_commit=False)

oauth2_scheme = OAuth2PasswordBearer(tokenUrl="/api/auth/login")

ALGORITHM = "HS256"
ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES = 60 * 24


def verify_password(plain_password: str, hashed_password: str) -> bool:
    if not plain_password or not hashed_password:
        return False
    try:
        return bcrypt.checkpw(
            plain_password.encode("utf-8"),
            hashed_password.encode("utf-8"),
        )
    except (ValueError, TypeError):
        return False


def get_password_hash(password: str) -> str:
    return bcrypt.hashpw(password.encode("utf-8"), bcrypt.gensalt()).decode("utf-8")


def create_access_token(data: dict, expires_delta: timedelta | None = None) -> str:
    to_encode = data.copy()
    expire = datetime.now(UTC) + (expires_delta or timedelta(minutes=ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES))
    to_encode.update({"exp": expire})
    return jwt.encode(to_encode, settings.secret_key, algorithm=ALGORITHM)


async def get_current_user(
    token: str = Depends(oauth2_scheme),
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
) -> User:
    credentials_exception = HTTPException(
        status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
        detail="Credenciais inválidas",
        headers={"WWW-Authenticate": "Bearer"},
    )
    try:
        payload = jwt.decode(token, settings.secret_key, algorithms=[ALGORITHM])
        if payload.get("purpose") == "mfa":
            raise credentials_exception
        username: str | None = payload.get("sub")
        if username is None:
            raise credentials_exception
    except JWTError as exc:
        raise credentials_exception from exc

    result = await db.execute(select(User).where(User.username == username))
    user = result.scalar_one_or_none()
    if user is None or not user.is_active:
        raise credentials_exception
    return user


def require_role(*roles: UserRole) -> Callable:
    allowed = set(roles)

    async def checker(user: User = Depends(get_current_user)) -> User:
        if user.role not in allowed:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN, detail="Permissão insuficiente")
        return user

    return checker


require_admin = require_role(UserRole.ADMIN)
require_operator = require_role(UserRole.ADMIN, UserRole.OPERATOR)
require_viewer = require_role(UserRole.ADMIN, UserRole.OPERATOR, UserRole.VIEWER)

async def _column_exists(conn, table: str, column: str) -> bool:
    result = await conn.execute(
        text(
            "SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns "
            "WHERE table_name = :table AND column_name = :column"
        ),
        {"table": table, "column": column},
    )
    return result.scalar() is not None


async def _add_column_if_missing(conn, table: str, column: str, ddl: str) -> None:
    if not await _column_exists(conn, table, column):

from pathlib import Path

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Header, HTTPException, status
from fastapi.responses import FileResponse, PlainTextResponse

from app.dependencies import require_admin, require_operator, require_viewer
from app.models import User
from app.schemas.enterprise import (
    AgentCreate,
    AgentCreateResponse,
    AgentHeartbeat,
    AgentMetricsPayload,
    AgentResponse,
    AgentUpdate,
)

router = APIRouter()


def _agent_package_dir() -> Path:
    """Resolve pasta do pacote lab (volume /agent, data/agent, ou repo)."""
    here = Path(__file__).resolve()
    candidates = [
        Path("/agent"),
        here.parents[2] / "data" / "agent",  # backend/app/data/agent
        here.parents[4] / "agent" if len(here.parents) > 4 else Path(),  # repo/agent
    ]
    for path in candidates:
        if path and (path / "sentinel_lab_agent.py").is_file():
            return path
    # fallback data even if empty (404 later)
    return here.parents[2] / "data" / "agent"


@router.get("/package/info")
async def agent_package_info(_: User = Depends(require_viewer)):
    root = _agent_package_dir()
    files = sorted(p.name for p in root.glob("*") if p.is_file()) if root.is_dir() else []
    return {
        "version": "0.2.0-lab",
        "package_dir": str(root),
        "files": files,
        "install_windows": {
            "download_ps1": "/api/agents/package/install-windows.ps1",
            "download_agent": "/api/agents/package/sentinel_lab_agent.py",
            "example": (
                'powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File install-windows.ps1 '
                '-Token "<token>" -Url "http://localhost:8800" -StartNow'
            ),
        },
        "docs": "docs/AGENT-LAB.md",
    }


@router.get("/package/{filename}")
async def download_agent_package_file(filename: str, _: User = Depends(require_viewer)):
    allowed = {
        "sentinel_lab_agent.py",
        "install-windows.ps1",
        "uninstall-windows.ps1",
    }
    if filename not in allowed:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Arquivo não disponível no pacote lab")
    path = _agent_package_dir() / filename
    if not path.is_file():
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Pacote lab não encontrado no servidor")
    media = "text/plain; charset=utf-8" if filename.endswith((".py", ".ps1")) else "application/octet-stream"
    return FileResponse(path, media_type=media, filename=filename)


@router.get("/install.ps1", response_class=PlainTextResponse)
async def agent_install_ps1_shortcut(_: User = Depends(require_viewer)):
    """Atalho para baixar o installer Windows (mesmo conteúdo do pacote)."""
    path = _agent_package_dir() / "install-windows.ps1"
    if not path.is_file():
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="install-windows.ps1 ausente")
    return PlainTextResponse(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"), media_type="text/plain; charset=utf-8")


@router.get("", response_model=list[AgentResponse])
async def list_agents(_: User = Depends(require_operator)):
    from app.db_sync import SyncSession
    from app.services.enterprise_service import list_agents

    with SyncSession() as session:
        return list_agents(session)


@router.post("", response_model=AgentCreateResponse, status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
async def create_agent(payload: AgentCreate, _: User = Depends(require_admin)):
    from app.db_sync import SyncSession
    from app.services.enterprise_service import create_agent, list_agents

    with SyncSession() as session:
        agent, token = create_agent(session, payload.model_dump())
        session.commit()
        rows = list_agents(session)
    row = next(r for r in rows if r["id"] == agent.id)
    return {**row, "token": token}


@router.patch("/{agent_id}", response_model=AgentResponse)
async def update_agent(agent_id: int, payload: AgentUpdate, _: User = Depends(require_admin)):
    from app.db_sync import SyncSession
    from app.services.enterprise_service import list_agents, update_agent

    with SyncSession() as session:
        agent = update_agent(session, agent_id, payload.model_dump(exclude_unset=True))
        if not agent:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Agente não encontrado")
        session.commit()
        rows = list_agents(session)
    return next(r for r in rows if r["id"] == agent_id)


@router.delete("/{agent_id}", status_code=status.HTTP_204_NO_CONTENT)
async def delete_agent(agent_id: int, _: User = Depends(require_admin)):
    from app.db_sync import SyncSession
    from app.services.enterprise_service import delete_agent

    with SyncSession() as session:
        if not delete_agent(session, agent_id):
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Agente não encontrado")
        session.commit()


@router.post("/heartbeat", response_model=AgentResponse)
async def agent_heartbeat(
    payload: AgentHeartbeat,
    authorization: str = Header(..., alias="Authorization"),
):
    from app.db_sync import SyncSession
    from app.services.enterprise_service import agent_heartbeat, list_agents

    token = authorization.removeprefix("Bearer ").strip()
    with SyncSession() as session:
        agent = agent_heartbeat(session, token, payload.version, payload.ip_address)
        if not agent:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Token de agente inválido")
        session.commit()
        rows = list_agents(session)
    return next(r for r in rows if r["id"] == agent.id)


@router.post("/metrics", response_model=AgentResponse)

    payload: AgentMetricsPayload,

    from app.db_sync import SyncSession
    from app.services.enterprise_service import ingest_agent_metrics, list_agents

    token = authorization.removeprefix("Bearer ").strip()
    with SyncSession() as session:
        agent = ingest_agent_metrics(session, token, payload.model_dump())
        if not agent:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Token de agente inválido")
        session.commit()
        rows = list_agents(session)
    return next(r for r in rows if r["id"] == agent.id)

import logging

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Request, status

)

    verify_totp,
)
from app.services.security_policy import password_change_required, validate_new_password

def _default_role() -> UserRole:
    mapping = {
        "admin": UserRole.ADMIN,
        "operator": UserRole.OPERATOR,
        "viewer": UserRole.VIEWER,
    }
    return mapping.get(settings.ldap_default_role.lower(), UserRole.VIEWER)


async def _authenticate_user(db: AsyncSession, username: str, password: str) -> User | None:
    result = await db.execute(select(User).where(User.username == username))
    user = result.scalar_one_or_none()

    if settings.ldap_enabled and authenticate_ldap(username, password):
        if user is None:
            user = User(
                username=username,
                hashed_password=get_password_hash(password),
                role=_default_role(),
                is_ldap=True,
                must_change_password=False,
                password_changed_at=datetime.now(UTC),
            )
            db.add(user)
            await db.commit()
            await db.refresh(user)
        return user

    if user and verify_password(password, user.hashed_password):
        return user
    return None


def _issue_access_token(user: User) -> str:
    return create_access_token(
        data={"sub": user.username, "role": user.role.value},
        expires_delta=timedelta(hours=24),
    )


def _issue_mfa_token(user: User) -> str:
    return create_access_token(
        data={"sub": user.username, "purpose": "mfa"},
        expires_delta=timedelta(minutes=5),
    )


def _audit(action: str, user: User) -> None:
    try:
        from app.db_sync import SyncSession
        from app.services.audit_service import log_audit

        with SyncSession() as session:
            log_audit(
                session,
                action=action,
                resource_type="user",
                resource_id=user.username,
                user_id=user.id,
                username=user.username,
                org_id=user.org_id,
            )
            session.commit()
    except Exception:
        logger.exception("Failed to write %s audit log", action)


def _user_response(user: User, *, must: bool | None = None) -> UserResponse:
    effective_must = (
        must
        if must is not None
        else password_change_required(user, max_age_days=settings.password_max_age_days)
    )
    return UserResponse(
        id=user.id,
        username=user.username,
        role=user.role,
        is_ldap=user.is_ldap,
        is_oidc=bool(getattr(user, "is_oidc", False)),
        is_active=user.is_active,
        must_change_password=effective_must,
        password_changed_at=user.password_changed_at,
        password_max_age_days=settings.password_max_age_days,
        mfa_enabled=bool(getattr(user, "mfa_enabled", False)),
        email=getattr(user, "email", None),
        org_id=user.org_id,
    )


@router.post("/login", response_model=Token)
async def login(
    request: Request,
    form_data: OAuth2PasswordRequestForm = Depends(),
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
):
    from app.services.rate_limit import limit_login

    limit_login(request)

    user = await _authenticate_user(db, form_data.username, form_data.password)
    if not user:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED, detail="Usuário ou senha inválidos")

    changed = False
    if not user.is_ldap and user.password_changed_at is None and not user.must_change_password:
        user.password_changed_at = datetime.now(UTC)
        changed = True

    must_change = password_change_required(user, max_age_days=settings.password_max_age_days)
    if must_change and not user.must_change_password and not user.is_ldap:
        user.must_change_password = True
        changed = True

    if changed:
        await db.commit()

    if bool(getattr(user, "mfa_enabled", False)) and getattr(user, "mfa_secret", None):
        return Token(
            access_token=None,
            token_type="mfa_required",
            must_change_password=must_change,
            mfa_required=True,
            mfa_token=_issue_mfa_token(user),
        )

    token = _issue_access_token(user)
    _audit("auth.login", user)
    return Token(access_token=token, must_change_password=must_change, mfa_required=False)


@router.post("/mfa/verify", response_model=Token)
async def verify_mfa(
    request: Request,

):
    from app.services.rate_limit import limit_auth_sensitive

    limit_auth_sensitive(request)

    try:
        payload = jwt.decode(body.mfa_token, settings.secret_key, algorithms=[ALGORITHM])
        if payload.get("purpose") != "mfa":
            raise JWTError("not mfa token")
        username = payload.get("sub")
        if not isinstance(username, str):
            raise JWTError("missing sub")
    except JWTError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Token MFA inválido ou expirado") from exc

    result = await db.execute(select(User).where(User.username == username))
    user = result.scalar_one_or_none()
    if not user or not user.is_active or not user.mfa_enabled:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="MFA não disponível para este usuário")

    secret = decrypt_mfa_secret(user.mfa_secret)
    if not secret or not verify_totp(secret, body.code):

    token = _issue_access_token(user)
    _audit("auth.mfa_verify", user)
    return Token(access_token=token, must_change_password=must_change, mfa_required=False)

import time

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, status
from sqlalchemy import select
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from app.config import settings
from app.database import get_db
from app.dependencies import require_operator, require_viewer
from app.engines.discovery.dns_resolver import iter_host_addresses, validate_subnet
from app.models import DiscoveryJob, DiscoveryJobStatus, User
from app.engines.discovery.scan_options import list_scan_defaults, resolve_scan_options
from app.schemas.discovery import (
    DiscoveryJobCreate,
    DiscoveryJobResponse,
    ScanDefaultsResponse,
)
from app.services.discovery_service import (
    cycle_discovery_job_ids_if_needed,
    fail_stuck_pending_discovery_jobs,
    fail_orphaned_discovery_jobs,
    fail_stale_discovery_jobs,
    has_active_discovery_job,
    prune_discovery_jobs,
    reconcile_cancelled_discovery_jobs,
    stop_discovery_job,
)
from app.workers.discovery_tasks import run_discovery_job

router = APIRouter()

MAX_JOBS = settings.discovery_jobs_max_history
_RECONCILE_INTERVAL_SECONDS = 30.0
_last_reconcile_monotonic = 0.0


def _maybe_reconcile_discovery_jobs() -> None:
    """Reconcilia jobs órfãos/stale no máximo a cada 30s (evita esgotar pool no polling)."""
    global _last_reconcile_monotonic
    now = time.monotonic()
    if now - _last_reconcile_monotonic < _RECONCILE_INTERVAL_SECONDS:
        return
    _last_reconcile_monotonic = now

    from app.db_sync import SyncSession

    with SyncSession() as session:
        stale = fail_stale_discovery_jobs(session)
        stuck = fail_stuck_pending_discovery_jobs(session)
        orphaned = fail_orphaned_discovery_jobs(session)
        reconciled = reconcile_cancelled_discovery_jobs(session)
        if stale or stuck or orphaned or reconciled:
            session.commit()


@router.get("", response_model=list[DiscoveryJobResponse])
async def list_discovery_jobs(
    limit: int = MAX_JOBS,
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
    _: User = Depends(require_viewer),
):
    cap = min(max(limit, 1), MAX_JOBS)

    _maybe_reconcile_discovery_jobs()

    result = await db.execute(
        select(DiscoveryJob).order_by(DiscoveryJob.created_at.desc()).limit(cap)
    )
    return result.scalars().all()


@router.get("/scan-defaults", response_model=ScanDefaultsResponse)
async def get_scan_defaults(_: User = Depends(require_viewer)):
    return list_scan_defaults()


def _build_scan_options_payload(payload: DiscoveryJobCreate) -> dict:
    if payload.scan_options:
        opts = payload.scan_options.model_dump(exclude_none=True)
    else:
        opts = {"profile": "standard"}

    if payload.scan_options is None or payload.scan_options.use_snmp is None:
        opts["use_snmp"] = payload.use_snmp
    community = payload.snmp_community or opts.get("snmp_community")
    if community:
        opts["snmp_community"] = community
    communities = payload.snmp_communities or opts.get("snmp_communities")
    if communities:
        opts["snmp_communities"] = [str(item).strip() for item in communities if str(item).strip()]
    return opts


@router.post("", response_model=DiscoveryJobResponse, status_code=status.HTTP_202_ACCEPTED)
async def start_discovery(
    payload: DiscoveryJobCreate,
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
    _: User = Depends(require_operator),
):
    try:
        validate_subnet(payload.subnet)
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST, detail=str(exc)) from exc

    from app.db_sync import SyncSession

    with SyncSession() as session:
        if has_active_discovery_job(session):
            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=status.HTTP_409_CONFLICT,
                detail="Já existe um scan em andamento. Cancele-o antes de iniciar outro.",
            )
        cycle_discovery_job_ids_if_needed(session)
        session.commit()

    scan_opts_dict = _build_scan_options_payload(payload)
    resolved = resolve_scan_options(
        scan_opts_dict,
        snmp_community_fallback=payload.snmp_community or settings.snmp_community,
    )

    job = DiscoveryJob(
        subnet=payload.subnet,
        use_snmp=resolved.use_snmp,
        snmp_community=resolved.snmp_community,
        snmp_communities=resolved.snmp_communities,
        scan_options=scan_opts_dict,
        status=DiscoveryJobStatus.PENDING,
        progress_percent=0,
        progress_label=f"Aguardando worker · perfil {resolved.label}",
        hosts_processed=0,
        devices_found=0,
        devices_inactive=0,
        total_hosts=len(iter_host_addresses(payload.subnet)),
    )
    db.add(job)
    await db.flush()

    async_result = run_discovery_job.apply_async(args=[job.id], queue="discovery", priority=9)
    job.celery_task_id = async_result.id
    await db.commit()
    await db.refresh(job)

    with SyncSession() as session:
        prune_discovery_jobs(session, keep=MAX_JOBS)
        session.commit()

    return job


@router.post("/{job_id}/stop", response_model=DiscoveryJobResponse)
async def stop_discovery(
    job_id: int,
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
    _: User = Depends(require_operator),
):
    job = await db.get(DiscoveryJob, job_id)
    if not job:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail="Job não encontrado")

    if job.status in (DiscoveryJobStatus.COMPLETED, DiscoveryJobStatus.FAILED):
        return job

    from app.db_sync import SyncSession

    with SyncSession() as session:
        sync_job = session.get(DiscoveryJob, job_id)
        if not sync_job:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail="Job não encontrado")
        stop_discovery_job(session, sync_job)
        session.commit()
        session.refresh(sync_job)
        response = DiscoveryJobResponse.model_validate(sync_job)

    return response


@router.get("/{job_id}", response_model=DiscoveryJobResponse)
async def get_discovery_job(
    job_id: int,
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
    _: User = Depends(require_viewer),
):
    job = await db.get(DiscoveryJob, job_id)
    if not job:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail="Job não encontrado")
    return job

    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
    user: User = Depends(require_viewer),
):
    platform = (payload.platform or "expo").strip().lower() or "expo"
    existing = await db.execute(select(PushToken).where(PushToken.token == payload.token))
    row = existing.scalar_one_or_none()
    if row:
        row.user_id = user.id
        row.platform = platform
        row.updated_at = datetime.now(UTC)
    else:
        row = PushToken(user_id=user.id, token=payload.token, platform=platform)
        db.add(row)
    await db.commit()
    await db.refresh(row)
    return PushTokenResponse(id=row.id, platform=row.platform, created_at=row.created_at.isoformat())

    from app.services.audit_service import log_audit
